title: Expose tenant-safe capability drift snapshots through operation observability

phases.objective: Expose canonical capability-registry drift as tenant-safe, stable snapshot signals without turning observability reads into repair execution or claiming persistent alert lifecycle before operational_alerts integration exists.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant user reading operation observability
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: GET /tenant/operations/observability after canonical User-JWT and active-membership authorization
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dashboard exposes only tenant-visible capability gap snapshots with stable dedupe keys, safe summaries, explicit non-persistent lifecycle, and non-executable remediation classification while execution observability remains available if capability views are degraded.
steps: Read execution observability with the existing tenant-scoped execution_log predicate.
Read canonical v_platform_capability_gaps joined to capability and maturity views, filtered to exposure_scope=tenant for tenant callers.
Project each visible gap into a stable signal ID and dedupe key with tenant/resource identity, evidence timestamp, severity, customer-safe summary, and platform-admin remediation guidance.
Strip internal source-table evidence from tenant signals while retaining richer evidence only for Admin projection.
Declare persistence.status=snapshot_only and auto_repair.eligible=false so discovery never claims alert persistence or repair execution.
If capability views are unavailable, return a degraded capability signal source while preserving the execution observability dashboard.
assertions: Tenant SQL and projection both exclude admin/internal capability gaps.
The same tenant/capability/gap produces the same dedupe key across observation timestamps.
Tenant signals contain no admin_evidence and report secrets_included=false.
Admin projection may include bounded registry/maturity evidence without secrets.
Capability drift signals never claim auto-repair eligibility and explicitly remain snapshot_only until operational_alerts persistence is wired.
Capability-view failure is fail-soft and does not take down execution observability.
No database migration, provider call, repair mutation, external send, Production action, or secret read is performed by this journey.
